x: JOE SCAMELL and BEN KNIFTON joined Belgrave in 1925, and the following year TOM MORELL, CHARLIE JONES, ALF HARLEY and LEN ROLLINS were accepted into membership.
JOHN FLOWER is back in England after sixteen months sojourn in the "White man's grave", and now has one ring on his sleeve. LEN ROLLINS is on board H.M.S.

I noticed Len Rollins looking very M.C.-ish, dancing with that air of detached boredom which characterises the really good dancer, as distinct from the plebian, chance-to-the-luck-and-the-girl's-good-temper enthusiasts [illegible]ke ourselves.
